comments.author: Tim Butler
comments.html:
Even more useful if the dtrace output could be
demangled automatically. Can you do that from
within the dtrace script itself, or is piping
through c++filt the only option?

comments.author: ahl
comments.html: Tim, that's going to be pretty much impossible to do from the D code itself. c++filt(1) is probably your best option.
